How much time is saved by taking Path 2 rather than Path 1?

questions.question_text:

Central to Museum: $3\text{ min}$
Museum to St James: $2\text{ min}$
St James to Circular Quay: $3\text{ min}$
Circular Quay to Wynyard: $2\text{ min}$
What is the travel time from Central to Wynyard?

Added an extra station step to the calculation.
Summed only the first two station intervals.

questions.question_text: In an electrical grid network diagram where vertices represent power substations and edges represent transmission lines, what does a weight of $18\text{ MW}$ assigned to edge $XY$ represent?

options.text: The power transmission capacity or energy loss along the power line between substations $X$ and $Y$
The total electrical power generated by substation $X$ alone
options.why: Confused the weight on a connecting edge with the power output of a single vertex.

options.text: The geographic distance in kilometres between substations $X$ and $Y$
options.why: Ignored the unit megawatts (MW) which represents electrical power rather than distance.

options.text: The number of high-voltage transformers installed at substation $Y$
options.why: Mistook the edge transmission rating for an equipment count inside a single substation.

questions.solution_text:
In network diagrams representing electrical grids:
1. Vertices represent nodes/substations.
2. Edges represent physical transmission lines connecting nodes.
3. Edge weights in MW represent power transmission capacity or transmission loss along that line.
A weight of $18\text{ MW}$ on edge $XY$ represents the power capacity or loss along that line.

options.why: Calculated the perimeter tour $A\text{–}B\text{–}C\text{–}D\text{–}A$ ($9 + 14 + 8 + 16 = 47\text{ km}$) instead of the specified route.
Omitted the final return leg $CA$ ($18\text{ km}$) back to the depot.
Substituted edge $DA$ ($16\text{ km}$) for the return leg back to Depot $A$ instead of edge $CA$ ($18\text{ km}$).

questions.solution_text:
$\text{Tour distance} = w(AB) + w(BD) + w(DC) + w(CA)$
$= 9 + 11 + 8 + 18$
$= 46\text{ km}$
